goal_intent: book a long table for eight and ask for it to be away from the door

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m calling to make a booking for a little get-together I’m organising with friends.
There will be eight of us—it's shaping up to be quite the gathering! We’re all really looking forward to catching up around a nice long table.
Thank you, that all sounds perfect! We’d like to book for this Saturday at 7:30pm—it should be a lovely evening. Let me know if that slot is available for us.

That all sounds great, thank you! If possible, could we please have the table set up away from the door? A bit of privacy would be wonderful for us to really enjoy the evening together. If that’s all sorted, then I’m all set—thanks so much! [END OF CALL]
